question.text: Which of the following statements regarding ozone is not correct?

options.text: The Ozone molecule is angular in shape
The Ozone is a resonance hybrid of two structures
The Oxygen-Oxygen bond length in ozone is identical with that of molecular oxygen
Ozone is used as germicide and disinfectant for the purification of air.

solution.text: Hints : Due to resonance the bond order in ozone is 1.5 , hence $\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{O}$ bond length in $\mathrm{O}_3>\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{O}$ bond length in $\mathrm{O}_2$
